title: Led Zeppelin IV
notes: Hard-rock riffs beside mandolin and recorder folk; mythic lyrics; Bonham's cavernous Headley Grange drums.

title: Led Zeppelin
notes: Heavy blues riffs, acoustic folk and raga touches, recorded almost live with distant mics.

title: Led Zeppelin II
notes: Riff-heavy blues-based hard rock cut between tour dates; theremin freakout and backwards echo.
